propositions: When an explicit reusable PydanticAIRunner is injected into agentic eval cases, its LLMConfig.repo_path retains the eval checkout root instead of being re-rooted to each disposable case fixture store.

The _effective_config method substitutes only per-request model and limit tuning while preserving the runner base repo_path, causing filesystem and ticket tools to read from the checkout instead of fixture repositories.

Completion-verifier cases that require fixture files (src/cli.py, app/profile.py) failed before the fix while operator-attested cases without fixture dependencies passed, demonstrating the root cause was fixture visibility.

The fix re-roots injected PydanticAIRunner instances at each disposable case store within eval_solver and clears tickets_path so ticket tools read the fixture's seeded store instead of the checkout's.
